'''KAS Eupen''' (short for '''Königliche Allgemeine Sportvereinigung Eupen''', English: ''Royal General Sports Association Eupen'', simply referred to as '''Eupen''') is a Belgian professional [[association football]] club located in [[Eupen]], [[Liège (province)|Province of Liège]], which currently plays in the [[Challenger Pro League]], the second tier of [[football in Belgium|Belgian football]]. The club was formed on 9 July 1945 through the merger of two older Eupen clubs, ''Jugend Eupen'' and ''FC Eupen 1920''.

The club has been playing at the [[Kehrwegstadion]] in Eupen since its inaugural season. Eupen is the first Belgian club based in the [[German-speaking Community of Belgium]] to have played in the Belgian top division."}}
